title: An Exact Pointwise Characterization for Total Variation Denoising in Quantile Regression
summary: Total variation denoising (TVD) is a classical method for denoising and curve fitting, yet an explicit pointwise description of its fitted values has only recently been established in the mean regression setting by arXiv:2410.03041v4. This raises the question of whether a similar representation holds for quantile regression. We answer this question affirmatively by deriving an exact minmax/maxmin representation for the quantile TVD estimator, providing a complete pointwise characterization of its solution set.
